zh-CN.title: 噪声叠加计算
zh-CN.intro: 噪声叠加计算器，对多个声源分贝按能量叠加(支持增减声源)，求总噪声水平，用于环境噪声评估。

en-US.title: Noise Superposition Calculator
en-US.intro: Combine multiple noise sources by energy addition, adding or removing sources to get the total environmental noise level.

zh-CN.title: 交通拥堵碳排
zh-CN.intro: 输入拥堵里程与车型油耗，估算怠速与低速行驶产生的额外燃油消耗与碳排放，用于拥堵治理环境效益评估。

en-US.title: Traffic Congestion Carbon Emissions
en-US.intro: Estimate the extra fuel burnt and CO2 emitted by idling and slow traffic from congested distance and vehicle consumption.

zh-CN.title: 废水处理负荷
zh-CN.intro: 输入废水流量与污染物浓度，估算污水处理厂进水的 COD 等污染物日负荷，用于工艺设计与达标评估。

en-US.title: Wastewater Treatment Load Calculator
en-US.intro: Estimate the daily COD and pollutant load entering a treatment plant from wastewater flow and pollutant concentration.

zh-CN.title: 噪音叠加计算
zh-CN.intro: 输入多个声源的声压级，按对数叠加公式计算总声压级（分贝不可直接相加），用于噪声源合并影响评估。

en-US.title: Noise Level Addition Calculator
en-US.intro: Add several sound sources with the logarithmic rule to get the combined level, since decibels cannot simply be summed.

zh-CN.title: 碳排放估算
zh-CN.intro: 输入电力、燃气等能源消耗量，按排放因子估算二氧化碳排放量，用于组织或个人碳足迹的粗略核算。

en-US.title: Carbon Emission Estimator
en-US.intro: Estimate CO2 emissions from electricity, gas and other energy use with standard emission factors for a rough carbon footprint.

zh-CN.title: AQI类别换算
zh-CN.intro: 依据 HJ 633-2012 标准实现空气质量指数(AQI)与 PM2.5、PM10、O3 等污染物浓度互相换算，便于解读空气质量日报与健康提示。

en-US.title: AQI Category Converter
en-US.intro: Convert between AQI and PM2.5, PM10 and O3 concentrations following the HJ 633-2012 breakpoint table.

zh-CN.title: 光伏减排估算
zh-CN.intro: 输入光伏年发电量，按等效植树（每棵年吸收 18kg CO₂）估算减排的二氧化碳量，用于绿电环境效益展示。

en-US.title: Solar PV Emission Reduction Estimator
en-US.intro: Convert annual solar PV generation into avoided CO2 and the equivalent number of trees planted.

zh-CN.title: 燃油碳排放
zh-CN.intro: 燃油碳排放计算器，按燃油消耗量与排放因子估算 CO₂(柴油约2.68 kgCO₂/L)，辅助交通与物流碳核算。

en-US.title: Fuel Carbon Emission Calculator
en-US.intro: Estimate CO2 from fuel consumption with emission factors (diesel about 2.68 kgCO2 per litre) for transport carbon accounting.

zh-CN.title: 垃圾填埋甲烷产量
zh-CN.intro: 输入填埋有机垃圾量，估算甲烷产量与 CO₂ 当量，并提示回收发电的减排潜力，用于固废管理评估。

en-US.title: Landfill Methane Generation
en-US.intro: Estimate methane and CO2-equivalent output from landfilled organic waste and the potential emission reduction from recovery.

zh-CN.title: 产品水足迹
zh-CN.intro: 输入产品种类与产量，估算其虚拟水消耗量（常远高于直接用水），用于产品水足迹与供应链用水评估。

en-US.title: Product Water Footprint
en-US.intro: Estimate the virtual water consumption of a product from its type and output for product water footprint and supply-chain assessment.

zh-CN.title: 节水率计算
zh-CN.intro: 输入采取节水措施前后的用水量，计算节水量与节水率，用于评估节水器具与管理的实际效果。

en-US.title: Water Saving Rate Calculator
en-US.intro: Compare water use before and after a saving measure to get the volume saved and the water saving rate.

zh-CN.title: 废水排放计算
zh-CN.intro: 废水排放计算器，求日排放量与污染物排放总量，辅助企业环保合规与排污许可核算(结果仅供参考)。

en-US.title: Wastewater Discharge Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute daily wastewater discharge and total pollutant load for environmental compliance and discharge permit accounting.

zh-CN.title: 噪声衰减距离
zh-CN.intro: 输入声源声压级与距离，按自由场模型估算点声源随距离的声压级衰减（dB），用于噪声环评与厂界预测。

en-US.title: Noise Attenuation Distance
en-US.intro: Estimate how a point sound source level falls off with distance in a free field for noise assessment and plant-boundary prediction.

zh-CN.title: 甲烷温室气体当量
zh-CN.intro: 输入甲烷排放量，按 GWP100 全球增温潜势折算为 CO₂ 当量，用于温室气体清单的统一核算与对比。

en-US.title: Methane CO2-Equivalent Calculator
en-US.intro: Convert methane emissions into CO2-equivalent using the 100-year global warming potential for greenhouse gas inventories.

zh-CN.title: 碳汇造林估算
zh-CN.intro: 输入林地面积、树种与林龄，估算森林或造林项目的年碳汇量，用于碳汇资产与碳中和测算参考。

en-US.title: Carbon Sink Afforestation Estimator
en-US.intro: Estimate the annual carbon sink of a forest or plantation from area, tree species and stand age.

zh-CN.title: 风电减排量
zh-CN.intro: 输入风电年发电量，按等效汽车年排放折算减排的二氧化碳量，用于风电项目环境效益测算。

en-US.title: Wind Power Emission Reduction
en-US.intro: Convert annual wind power generation into avoided CO2 and the equivalent annual car emissions.

zh-CN.title: 固废产生量
zh-CN.intro: 固废产生量估算器，按人口与人均产生量估算生活垃圾总量，辅助市政环卫与处理设施规划。

en-US.title: Solid Waste Generation Estimator
en-US.intro: Estimate total municipal solid waste from population and per-capita generation for sanitation and facility planning.

zh-CN.title: 碳汇造林投资
zh-CN.intro: 输入造林面积、树种与单价，估算碳汇造林项目的投资与年固碳吸收量，辅助碳中和方案的成本测算。

en-US.title: Afforestation Cost Calculator
en-US.intro: Estimate the investment of an afforestation carbon-sink project from planting area, tree species and unit price, together with its annual carbon uptake.

zh-CN.title: 能源效率换算
zh-CN.intro: 能源效率换算器，将不同能源单位折算为标准煤或 kWh 便于对比，辅助能耗与节能评估。

en-US.title: Energy Efficiency Converter
en-US.intro: Convert energy between units and into coal equivalent or kWh for like-for-like efficiency comparison.

zh-CN.title: AQI 健康等级
zh-CN.intro: AQI 健康等级器，根据空气质量指数给出健康影响等级与活动建议，辅助污染天出行与防护决策。

en-US.title: AQI Health Level Guide
en-US.intro: Turn an air quality index value into a health impact level with outdoor activity advice for polluted days.

zh-CN.title: 碳中和林面积
zh-CN.intro: 输入年碳排放量，估算抵消所需种植的树木数量与林地面积，给出碳中和造林规模的粗略参考。

en-US.title: Carbon-Neutral Forest Area Calculator
en-US.intro: Estimate how many trees and how much forest land are needed to offset a given annual carbon emission.

zh-CN.title: 生态足迹估算
zh-CN.intro: 输入消费数据，用经验系数粗略估算人均生态足迹（gha），并与全球人均生物承载力对比，用于可持续消费参考。

en-US.title: Ecological Footprint Estimator
en-US.intro: Estimate per-capita ecological footprint from consumption data and compare it with the global per-capita biocapacity.

zh-CN.title: 污水处理厂能耗
zh-CN.intro: 输入处理水量与电耗，估算污水处理厂的单位能耗（kWh/m³），用于工艺能效对比与节能改造评估。

en-US.title: Wastewater Plant Energy Consumption
en-US.intro: Compute the specific energy consumption of a wastewater treatment plant in kWh per cubic metre of treated water.

zh-CN.title: 电池储能容量
zh-CN.intro: 电池储能容量计算器，按容量、电压与放电深度估算可用电量，辅助储能系统与离网供电规划。

en-US.title: Battery Storage Capacity Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute usable energy from rated capacity, voltage and depth of discharge for storage and off-grid power planning.

zh-CN.title: 建筑能耗指标
zh-CN.intro: 输入建筑能耗与建筑面积，计算单位面积能耗指标（kWh/m²/年），用于建筑节能对标与能效评估。

en-US.title: Building Energy Intensity Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute building energy intensity in kWh per square metre per year for benchmarking and retrofit assessment.

zh-CN.title: 日常节水量
zh-CN.intro: 输入采取节水器具或习惯前后的用水量，估算累计节水量，用于家庭与公共机构节水成效的直观展示。

en-US.title: Daily Water Saving Calculator
en-US.intro: Estimate cumulative water saved by efficient fixtures and habits in homes and public buildings.

zh-CN.title: 风力发电估算
zh-CN.intro: 输入风轮扫风面积、风速与空气密度，按功率公式计算风力机输出功率，并提示切入与切出风速限制，用于风电评估。

en-US.title: Wind Power Output Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute wind turbine output power from swept area, wind speed and air density, with cut-in and cut-out speed limits.

zh-CN.title: 环境影响评分
zh-CN.intro: 输入能耗、水耗、废弃物与排放等数据，综合评分量化产品或项目的环境影响（分越高影响越大），用于方案对比。

en-US.title: Environmental Impact Score
en-US.intro: Score energy, water, waste and emission data into a single environmental impact index for comparing options.

zh-CN.title: 太阳能发电量
zh-CN.intro: 输入光伏装机容量、日照时数与效率，估算一段时间内的发电量，用于光伏项目收益与环境效益测算。

en-US.title: Solar Power Output Calculator
en-US.intro: Estimate PV output over a period from installed capacity, sunshine hours and system efficiency for yield and benefit estimates.

zh-CN.title: 绿化覆盖率
zh-CN.intro: 输入绿地面积与区域总面积，计算绿化覆盖率（乔木投影按半面积折算），用于园林与城市规划指标核算。

en-US.title: Green Coverage Rate Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute the green coverage ratio from green space and total area, counting tree canopy at half its projection.

zh-CN.title: 固废产生系数估算
zh-CN.intro: 基于行业产排污系数手册，输入产品产量估算固体废物产生量，用于工业企业固废管理与合规核算参考。

zh-CN.intro: 输入垃圾总量与回收量，计算分类回收率与剩余填埋量，用于评估垃圾分类成效与减量目标进度。

en-US.title: Waste Recycling Rate Calculator
en-US.intro: Compute the recycling rate and residual landfill volume from total and recycled waste to track sorting performance.

en-US.intro: Estimate household waste generation from family size, cooking and shopping habits, with practical reduction suggestions.
